name: Yumemizaka
source:
This game is a story about the adventures of a pizza delivery guy. He meets and have fun with his female customers and friends. His store advertising campaign brings him to a house of three sisters. There he is treated to some interesting stuff...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160402092638/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-m.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
这款游戏讲述一名披萨外送员的冒险。他会遇见女性顾客和朋友，并与她们一同享乐。店铺的宣传活动把他带到三姐妹的家中，在那里，他受到了一番有趣的招待……

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160402092638/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-m.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
